system.description:
DISCIPLE MYSTIC STANCE

Prerequisites Primal or Transcendent Monastic Path

You adopt the Dragon Stance, executing formidable leg strikes reminiscent of a dragon's mighty tail. You gain a +2-circumstance bonus to AB and your attacks gaining the sweep trait.

While in Dragon Stance, you can ignore the first square of difficult terrain while Striding.

Automated: press Use to enter the stance: 1 AP, under the system's stance rules (one stance at a time, or two with Stance Mastery; Reactive Stance enters it free at initiative). It lasts until you enter another stance or delete its effect. While in it: +2 circumstance to your attack rolls; your unarmed attacks (fists, gauntlets, Monastic weapons) have the Sweep trait (Graham's B6-2); and on each Stride the first square of difficult terrain costs you nothing extra. The Path is checked when you enter it.
